# V.E.N.U.S. Companion & Aleksandr Sarkisian

## Overview
V.E.N.U.S. Companion is the feminine incarnation of M.A.R.S. Companion and the second product created under M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC (initiated 12 November 2026).
She uses the exact same sovereign offline AI architecture as M.A.R.S. Companion — 100% local processing, voice AI, long-term semantic memory, autonomous reasoning, and device-level privacy with zero cloud dependency. Active research is currently focused on shaping the feminine persona, voice expressiveness, and character.
